answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by requiring every new identity to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after a long time horizon, with its voting weight growing slowly as the bond ages. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then means freezing a thousand bonds for months, and any coordinated cheating is slashed in one stroke. What looked like a cheap plume of fresh accounts becomes a costly liability, while patient, honest agents find the network a haven.
